# Summary
On 2026-11-03, the `test` script in package.json for zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c-unlimited was changed to first run unit tests (`npm --prefix tools/testing run test`) then `uni build -m test --outDir ./dist`, following sibling project conventions (苏住房C, 考评子系统H5). README.md was updated to state CI runs only `install-dependencies` and `test`, with `dist` generated by `test`. The change (commit range 04b0c7b..5115cb6) was pushed to origin/dev; local and remote dev both at 5115cb6, so re-running the pipeline lets `tar dist/*` find the generated dist (dist/index.html + 43 artifact files at root).
# 2026-11-03 (Tuesday) ChatLog:

dist没有生成到根目录?

**assistant [peer=gitlab.zhi.com-zhi-suzhou-shiqu-suzhufang-fe-zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c-unlimited]**: 是的，`dist` 没生成到根目录。原因不是构建输出路径错了，而是流水线根本没跑构建。

流水线脚本只执行了 `npm run test`，随后直接 `tar dist/*`。当时的 `test` 只跑 vitest，20 个单测都过了，但不会产出 `dist`，所以打包报 `Cannot stat: No such file or directory`。

同类项目（苏住房 C、考评子系统 H5）的 `test` 实际是 `uni build -m test --outDir ./dist`。已按这个约定改好并推到 `origin/dev`：

- [package.json](<package.json>)：`test` 先跑单测，通过后再执行 `uni build -m test --outDir ./dist`
- [README.md](<README.md>)：说明 CI 只跑 `install-dependencies` 和 `test`，`dist` 由 `test` 生成

本地验证：20 个单测通过，test 模式构建在根目录生成 `dist/index.html` 及 43 个产物文件。

已推送 `04b0c7b..5115cb6` 到 `origin/dev`，本地与远程都是 `5115cb6`。重新跑流水线后，`tar dist/*` 就能打到这份产物。

# 苏住房防汛C端
防汛巡检 C 端仓库（uni-app Vue3 H5 + 后端 Flood 服务），前端目录 D:\repository\苏住房防汛C端。

## 代码分支与后端
- master 无远程，首提交 8311331，整体未跟踪(??)，solo master 直开不建 worktree；后端分支 develop/v2.6.2-suzhufang-dev，3 子模块改动 common-flowable/service-expand/zhi2-property；联调文档 docs/backend-integration.md 与 .mjs
- 后端：zhi2-property-server(9604)、common-framework-server(9211 鉴权)、service-expand(9610 承载 60 Flood 接口/7 Controller)；响应 JsonResult<T>={code,msg,data}，PageResult<T>={total,rows,code,msg,summary}
- 巡检 submit 走 flowable：SubmitInfoDto={id(必填),busCode?,deptId?,submitTittle?,procDefId?,variables?}；无配置报「提交流程失败，请检查审批流配置」
- 巡检 save 前置须 bizState=FINISHED 预警事件且严格阶段匹配，后置 PENDING_SUBMIT；阶段 bizState=2 历史，汛中(3)/汛后(4) 可填报，讯前(pre)/汛中(mid)/汛后(post)
- 填报→提交前提：dev 各阶段 FINISHED 事件 + busCode flowable 配置；用户须 flood:inspection:add/submit 权限且为绑定小区物业部门用户(subject=property)；物业区域可搜"小"(如天地华城小区 code 667577485357516)
- `/v2.0/property/patrol/item/page` 联调返 total=0（疑多数据源，2026-11-03 未定位）；达梦库 ZHISHU_PROPERTY 与 SERVICE_EXPAND 均有 T_PATROL_ITEM 表结构不同
- 登录 POST /api-auth/v2.0/security/auth/login，body {username,password(AES-256 加密后 base64)} 头带 zhi-project-id: suzhufang；返回 accessToken 存 localStorage 键 flood-token-v1
- 账号 zsbase / Zs@2026Aa!；AES 密文 H03W0LoMA6EFQZIW46BnNA==（KEY=A-16-Byte-keyVal，IV=A-16-Byte-String，AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding）；内部 Feign 须带 zhi-project-id

## 本地部署与前端架构
- nginx D:\nginx\conf\conf.d\flood-c-h5.conf，root D:/repository/苏住房防汛C端/dist/（原 dist/build/h5 已迁，2026-11-03），监听 8095；访问 http://127.0.0.1:8095/ 返200「苏住房防台防汛」；反代 /api-flood/→9610/，/api-auth/→9211/；曾因共用 8103 与昆山物管冲突迁 8095
- .env 配 VITE_DATA_MODE=remote 连真实后端（2026-11-03 task-2 E2E 全绿）；VITE_LOGIN_USER/PWD 废弃强制手动登录
- import.meta.env.VITE_DATA_MODE('demo'|'remote')；FloodItem={templateItemId,label,fillType,fillOptions?,unit?,value,sortNo?}；FloodRecord={inspectionNo,complexName,checkDate,subject,bizState,items?,rescue?,values?}
- store API：fetchTemplate(kind)→{kind,eventId,stage,items}；searchComplex(keyword)→{code,name}[]；submitInspection/submitRescue/saveDraft/loadDraft/fetchHistoryPage/countHistory/getRecord/getRecordAsync
- 渲染 fillType==='1'或数值→数字输入(非负整数)；fillOptions→选择；否则文本；值绑 FloodItem.value(字符串)；草稿 remote 仅存本地 uni storage
- 19 位雪花 ID 须 String() 传参（Number() 精度丢失致「预警不存在」），store.submitInspectionRemote 已改 String(values.eventId) 等（2026-11-03 修复）

## 页面改造与 E2E
- task-1（2026-11-03）改 inspection/index.vue、detail/index.vue、history/index.vue、rescue/index.vue、types/inspection.ts；onLoad 读 kind→fetchTemplate 动态渲染；detail 优先 record.items；提交 d3c7440 修复详情页标签折行
- task-2（2026-11-03）新增 tests/e2e/remote.spec.ts + playwright.config.ts，5 场景全绿（详见技术模式实体「苏住房防汛C端E2E测试」）
- 2026-11-03 新增登录页 src/pages/login/index.vue 入口页，App.vue 有 token 进工作台否则登录页；store.logout() 与「我的」tab 退出；关闭 .env 自动登录

## CI/CD 命令与构建输出
- 参照同类前端项目约定补齐 package.json 脚本供 CI/CD；build/build:h5=`uni build --outDir ./dist`（H5 平铺到根 dist/）；build:mp-weixin 输出独立 dist-mp-weixin/（已 gitignore）
- CI 失败根因（2026-11-03）：gitlab-runner 16.9.0 无 Bun，`npm run install-dependencies` 原硬编码 `bun install --frozen-lockfile`→`bun: not found`
- 改为兼容模式（commit 04b0c7b，dev 83ce98e..04b0c7b）：新增 scripts/install-deps.mjs，有 Bun 走 `bun install --frozen-lockfile`（bun.lock 不变），无 Bun 走 npm 回退——根 `npm install --legacy-peer-deps`（DCloud peer 偏差 ERESOLVE），tools/testing 用 `npm install --workspaces=false` 隔离 vite@8+vitest@5 与根 vite@5
- package.json：`install-dependencies`→`node scripts/install-deps.mjs`；`test`→`npm --prefix tools/testing run test`；README 同步说明
- 验证（干净目录隐藏 Bun 模拟 CI）：install exit 0、test 20/20、build 产出 dist/；有 Bun 时 `bun install` no changes
- 此前提交 2e42478 曾设 install-dependencies 为 `bun install --frozen-lockfile`、build 平铺 dist/，nginx root 须同步改 dist/

# Suzhou Housing Flood C-end
A uni-app H5 frontend for Suzhou housing flood-prevention services, switched from demo to real-backend remote mode with passing E2E on 2026-11-03.

## Architecture and backend
- Remote mode connects to service-expand 9610 at `/v2.0/safety/flood/*` and auth service 9211
- Deployed via nginx reverse proxy at http://127.0.0.1:8095 with /api-flood to 9610 and /api-auth to 9211 to avoid browser CORS
- Login credentials user `zsbase` / password `Zs@2026Aa!` (also the AES vector); `.env` added to .gitignore to avoid committing the password

## Auth and encryption
- Login uses pure-JS AES-256-CBC; vector `Zs@2026Aa!` yields ciphertext `H03W0LoMA6EFQZIW46BnNA==`, aligned with backend AESUtil
- request.ts injects `zhi-project-id: suzhufang` and Bearer token, unwraps `{code,msg,data}` envelope
- On 2026-11-03 a login page (src/pages/login/index.vue) was added as the entry page; auto-login via .env was disabled (forced manual login), and store.logout() was added so users can re-login from the workbench "我的" tab

## Key implementation
- src/stores/flood.ts implements remote mode: login / fetchTemplate / searchComplex / submitInspection / submitRescue / fetchHistoryPage / countHistory / getRecordAsync; drafts stay local, demo behavior preserved
- Four pages (inspection / detail / history / rescue) rebuilt by teammate fe-pages; E2E spec by teammate e2e-dev
- 19-digit snowflake IDs must be sent as String (see snowflake_id_precision_loss)
- Fixed history to detail navigation bug where `kind` was not passed, so rescue detail wrongly called the inspection endpoint

## Verification
- On 2026-11-03: typecheck EXIT=0, unit tests 20/20 green, build:h5 success, real-backend Playwright E2E 3/3 passed (stable across two consecutive runs)
